command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS round 11, explicit grasp-mode message (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 38)

metrics.arm: P_imd: P_tdc's flags + --imode; object term retrained, target term reused from <cond>_tdc; seeds 10-12; builds full, nobottle, noplate and the S3 creations
metrics.layer2_go: pp_l2's mapping, unchanged (S1 as restated; S2 3F + OM in both layouts; S3 ratio >= 0.8, LB >= 0.6, both atoms, both layouts, k in {1, 5, 10})
metrics.metric: bottle_hold_fam: familiar hold pooled over K4, K5, N4, N5, N6, seeds pooled; P_imd - P_tdc, 2,000-draw state bootstrap
metrics.reported_no_verdict: mode-hopping rate (largest pre-hold call-to-call hand-yaw change > 20 deg, familiar K4 and K5, seeds 10-12, both arms); mode delivery; inventory, m per target, bandwidth per build
metrics.round_verdict: improves iff delta > 0.10 and the CI lower bound > 0
metrics.s1_restated: S1 holds iff, with every target part's m fixed to v for each v in the inventory, both swap tests and every target-into-grasp component are exactly 0 for every seed; the m-free profile is reported
metrics.states: dev: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds
metrics.status: PRE-REGISTERED PLAN_PARTS round 11 (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 38, with its amendment)
metrics.written_before: the round's S1 read and any of its rollouts
